12df9200: What is the protagonist's number in season 1 of Squid Game?
Seong Gi-hun wears number 456. Indebted and desperate, he is the last survivor thanks to his human instincts and his compassion for the other players.
b97e9939: What is the first game of season 1?
Red Light, Green Light: players must reach the finish line without moving when the doll looks at them. Those eliminated are killed on the spot.
fdd848ca: How much money does the winner of season 1 receive?
45.6 billion won: 100 million won for each of the 456 players. A fortune worth tens of millions of dollars.
648eb363: Oh Il-nam, the games' ailing founder
Oh Il-nam is the founder of the games, a terminally ill rich man who plays himself to feel alive again. His reveal is the final twist of season 1.
0b49e816: Which game involves carving a shape out of a sugar candy?
Dalgona is a Korean candy stamped with a shape (star, triangle, umbrella, circle) that must be cut out without breaking it. Some shapes are almost impossible, dooming the players.
e0305a25: What uniform do the guards wear?
The guards wear pink jumpsuits and masks marked with a shape: circle for workers, triangle for armed soldiers and square for managers.
530bdc3c: How many players take part in season 1?
456 heavily indebted players take part in the games. The last number belongs to Gi-hun, who goes on to win.
893fe546: What is the twist of the marbles game?
They play in teams against robots
Each pair must face off, and one will die
The players form pairs, then realize they must play against each other and that one of them will die. This brutal twist splits up friends and creates heartbreaking moments.
086ffaa8: Who is the Front Man and how is he linked to another character?
The undercover policeman Jun-ho is his brother
A former winner of the games
The Front Man is Hwang In-ho, brother of the policeman Hwang Jun-ho who infiltrates the games. In-ho was himself a former winner who chose to become the Front Man.
5628d7dd: What is the final game that gives the series its name?
The squid game is a traditional Korean playground game drawn on the ground, with attackers and defenders. Gi-hun wins using what he learned playing it as a child.
0db072c8: Why do the players agree to come back after voting to stop?
Their financial despair drives them to return voluntarily

After the majority votes to stop, the players are released. But faced with their real financial distress, most choose to come back of their own accord, a central piece of the series' social commentary.
e2e5682f: Which player is the main antagonist among the players in season 1?
Jang Deok-su (player 101) is the brutal gangster who forms violent alliances and betrays without remorse. His arrogance contrasts with the main characters' vulnerability.
0fc00382: Squid Game is South Korean, created by Hwang Dong-hyuk for Netflix. In 2021 it became Netflix's most-watched series, reaching 111 million households.
714559a0: In season 2, what does Gi-hun do instead of flying to America?
He infiltrates the new games to destroy them
Gi-hun refuses to leave and chooses to infiltrate the new games: he returns with a new number and a mission to destroy them from the inside in season 2.
b0b64a74: What does Gi-hun receive in the subway at the start of the series?
A game card with a number
Gi-hun receives a card with a phone number after playing ddakji, a Korean folded-paper game: that is how he is invited to the games. The opening scene sets the tone.
776b9a08: What is the name of the paper game played in the opening scene of Squid Game?
Ddakji is a traditional Korean game played with folded paper tiles: you have to flip your opponent's tile by slamming yours onto it. The mysterious man (Gong Yoo) recruits Gi-hun through this game.
88c6f9a7: Which famous Korean actor plays the mysterious recruiter in the first scene?
Gong Yoo (famous for Train to Busan) plays the mysterious recruiter in a gray suit who plays ddakji with Gi-hun in the subway, a cameo by a major Korean star.
22dd1d36: What outfit does the Front Man wear in Squid Game?
Black clothing and an angular black mask
The Front Man wears black clothing and an angular black mask, which set him apart from the guards in pink.
5d644c81: In which memorable scene does Gi-hun take on the mysterious man (Gong Yoo)?
By challenging him at ddakji and refusing to lose
By exposing him to the police

Gi-hun plays ddakji against the recruiter (Gong Yoo) and gets slapped after every loss, but he refuses to give up until he wins. That tenacity shows the character that will help him survive the games.
5243dbe7: What is the name of Gi-hun's daughter?
Ga-yeong is Gi-hun's daughter. Their distant relationship, caused by his gambling and debts, is his main motivation: he wants to win for her.
dc730f77: How does Gi-hun use his knowledge of the childhood squid game to win?
He has known the exact rules since childhood and exploits each side's zones
Gi-hun played the squid game as a child in his neighborhood: he knows the attack and defense zones drawn on the ground perfectly, which lets him find strategies that Sang-woo does not anticipate.
ada26076: What is the name of the policeman who infiltrates the games to find his missing brother?
Hwang Jun-ho is the policeman who sneaks into the games disguised as a guard. He discovers the Front Man's identity (his brother In-ho), is shot and falls into the sea.
211a2f1d: Who is the creator and director of Squid Game?
Hwang Dong-hyuk is the creator, writer and director of Squid Game. He worked on the concept for about ten years before Netflix took it on.
c4fc4d09: How many episodes does season 1 of Squid Game have?
Season 1 has 9 episodes, following the 6 games in order, interspersed with character development and policeman Jun-ho's investigation.
6ee88631: What is the Korean rhyme sung during Red Light, Green Light?
“Mugunghwa kkoch-i pieot seumnida” (“The hibiscus flower has bloomed”) is the rhyme sung by the doll, a traditional Korean children's rhyme that takes on a terrifying meaning here.
cf9ded5d: Which shape appears on the masks of the managers, the highest-ranking guards?
The square marks the managers, above the soldiers (triangle) and the workers (circle). The Front Man wears a black mask.
a577f124: What is the main rule of the marbles game?
Play any game you like to win all of your opponent's marbles
The rule is to win ALL of your opponent's marbles within 30 minutes, with any marble game allowed. That freedom leads to emotional manipulation and deception between partners.
4e15be1b: How does Gi-hun manage to win the marbles game against Oh Il-nam?
By taking advantage of the old man's apparent confusion
Gi-hun takes advantage of Oh Il-nam's apparent confusion to take his marbles. We later understand that the old man knew exactly what he was doing.
cfe9d6ac: Roughly how much is the season 1 prize worth in dollars?
45.6 billion won is worth roughly 30 to 35 million dollars depending on the exchange rate, an immense fortune for players from Korea's indebted working class.
122b22b9: What was Gi-hun's job before the games?
Former auto worker who was laid off
Gi-hun is a former car factory worker laid off after a strike. His dismissal symbolizes the economic insecurity the series criticizes through its indebted characters.
36261752: What is the link between Sang-woo (player 218) and Gi-hun?
They grew up in the same neighborhood
Cho Sang-woo and Gi-hun grew up in the same working-class neighborhood of Ssangmun-dong. Sang-woo was the neighborhood's bright kid who went into finance before turning to fraud.
b449f1f4: How does the final duel between Gi-hun and Sang-woo end?
Sang-woo kills himself with a knife to let Gi-hun win
They agree to share the prize
Sang-woo stabs himself in the neck to let Gi-hun win, an ambiguous final act between sacrifice and escape from shame. He asks him to look after his mother.
46709a8a: What is the number of the North Korean defector Sae-byeok in season 1?
Kang Sae-byeok wears number 067, a North Korean defector playing to save her family. Her brutal death at Sang-woo's hands is one of the most shocking in the series.
8b7485e8: How does Gi-hun react when he gets his money and returns to the real world?
He lives normally and enjoys the money
Traumatized, he barely touches the money for a year
Traumatized, Gi-hun barely touches the money for a year and is eaten up by guilt. His mother died while he was away.
316d275a: Which symbol is on the business card given to recruit candidates?
A circle, a triangle and a square
The recruitment card shows three geometric shapes: circle, triangle and square, the same as on the guards' masks. This minimalist design has become iconic.
ece5ba4d: What is the name of the giant doll in Red Light, Green Light?
The giant doll is called Young-hee, a name taken from old Korean school textbooks. She has become the series' visual emblem.
ec17db21: Which Korean actor plays Gi-hun (player 456) in Squid Game?
Lee Jung-jae plays Seong Gi-hun. His performance won him the 2022 Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series, a first for a non-English-language role.
803870fb: Which actor plays Cho Sang-woo (player 218) in Squid Game?
Park Hae-soo plays Cho Sang-woo, Gi-hun's brilliant but morally compromised childhood friend. The role made him an international star.
1f2033f7: Which actress plays Kang Sae-byeok (player 067) in Squid Game?
Jung Ho-yeon plays Kang Sae-byeok. A model before Squid Game, this was her first major acting role, and it won her a SAG Award in 2022.
a4cfbd6d: What is the 3rd game of season 1, after Red Light, Green Light and Dalgona?
The third game is tug of war, high above a drop. Gi-hun's team wins thanks to Oh Il-nam's advice and Sang-woo's idea of taking three steps forward.
fd144fe6: What does Gi-hun see at the end of season 1, just before boarding his plane?
A new invitation in his pocket
The subway recruiter luring another man with ddakji
The Front Man without his mask
In the subway, Gi-hun spots the recruiter playing ddakji with a new man. He realizes the games are continuing, gives up his flight and decides to act.
c4a8ca36: Which game opens the first round of season 2 of Squid Game?
Red Light, Green Light returns as the first game of season 2, in a different context. The doll Young-hee remains the merciless referee of this first elimination round.
98c09d30: What main social theme does Squid Game criticize through its characters?
Extreme economic inequality and the despair of Korea's working class
Squid Game criticizes extreme economic inequality: every player is buried in debt and despair, reflecting the reality of over-indebtedness and insecurity in Korea and beyond.
b38b1afa: What was Ali Abdul's (player 199) situation before the games?
Ali Abdul is a Pakistani migrant worker whose boss withheld his wages. He joins the games to provide for his family. His kindness and loyalty make him especially endearing.
5acf1305: Who betrays Ali Abdul during the marbles game, leading to his death?
Sang-woo, who tricks him out of his marbles
Cho Sang-woo betrays Ali during the marbles game: he gets Ali to hand over his bag of marbles, then swaps them for pebbles. Ali is eliminated without understanding the betrayal.
e54cc95d: How many seasons does Squid Game have?
Squid Game has three seasons: the first in 2021, the second in December 2024 and the last in June 2025.
d8d6758f: What is the 5th game of season 1 (before the final squid game)?
The Glass Bridge is the 5th game: the 16 survivors of the marbles game must cross a bridge by choosing between tempered and ordinary glass. The crossing order proves crucial.
9e6e5524: What trick does Gi-hun use to cut out the umbrella from his dalgona?
He licks the back of the candy to soften it
Gi-hun drew the hardest shape, the umbrella. By licking the back of the candy, he melts the sugar and manages to free the shape.
6e644d1d: Which real-life game show reproduces the structure of Squid Game?
Red Light, Green Light Game Show
Squid Game: The Challenge is a real Netflix show (2023): 456 real contestants take part in non-lethal versions of the games to win $4.56 million. It drew controversy over its filming conditions.
91a9d37e: Which player figures out how to spot the safe panels on the Glass Bridge?
A glassmaker who recognizes tempered glass
A player who has worked with glass for years can tell from experience which panel is tempered. The organizers turn off the lights to stop him from helping the others.
4b831cf2: What does each geometric shape represent in the guards' hierarchy?
Circle = worker, triangle = soldier, square = manager
Square = soldier, triangle = manager, circle = worker
Circle = manager, triangle = worker, square = soldier
Star = leader, circle = guard, triangle = recruiter
The circle marks workers, the triangle armed soldiers and the square managers. The Front Man stands above them all.
ae87c94f: How do the organizers make sure the candidates take part voluntarily?
Each player signs a consent form

Each player signs a three-clause consent form: 1. A player is not allowed to stop playing. 2. A player who refuses to play will be eliminated. 3. The games may be terminated if the majority agrees. This veneer of legality is meant to justify the games.
5525ab36: What is the dominant color of the players' uniforms in Squid Game?
The players wear teal-green tracksuits, contrasting with the guards' pink. The color evokes prison or hospital clothing, underlining the players' dehumanization.
3a531eb8: What is the name of the fictional company that runs the games?
The organization has no official name in the series: it is identified only by its geometric symbols. That deliberate anonymity reinforces its mystery and its absolute power.
dab8e97b: What was the estimated production budget of Squid Game season 1?
Season 1 reportedly cost about 21 million dollars, a little over 2 million per episode, a modest budget for Netflix's most-watched series.
